failedRun.head: historical-commit-018
failedRun.diagnostic: Go source detected but no source built/processed
failedRun.evidenceBoundary: Job metadata and fatal annotations available. Complete hosted log was not retrieved because anonymous access was denied; no claim to have read missing logs. The incremental/disk-space annotation is generic and is not the established cause.

rootCause.summary: The verified Go executable is statically linked; CodeQL 2.27.4 explicitly reports indirectTracingSupportsStaticBinaries=false. The pinned Action uses a dynamically linked shell wrapper for Go on Linux, but our helper directly executed the absolute prepared Go binary, bypassing the required entry. Preparation also occurred after init and did not publish the prepared compiler directory, so init could only discover the runner compiler. Preserving environment variables alone does not repair this missing dynamic entry.
proof: Pinned github/codeql-action commit 9b3254085494b55a0f7c4c2b3d2d52cc712ce370 init-action.ts lines542-580 installs the static Go wrapper and exports CODEQL_ACTION_GO_BINARY. analyze.ts lines711-741 requires compiler setup before init.
Official CLI 2.27.4 asset SHA256 matches GitHub release metadata; actual version JSON confirms feature=false and the fixed Go1.26.10 is a statically linked ELF.
On the isolated Linux host, the original actual helper and real reviewed Go source with a new empty compiler cache build successfully but database finalize returns32 with the same no-source error.

A separate database using the corrected entry successfully compiles, imports TRAP and finalizes. A further final-state run binds the final helper SHA, verifies --prepare PATH output, uses the official wrapper body, finalizes and analyzes successfully.

fixes: Prepare Node, Python and the verified Go toolchain before CodeQL init; publish only the prerequisite-validated compiler directory via GITHUB_PATH.
Build only through the init-exported CODEQL_ACTION_GO_BINARY, with no direct-binary fallback. Accept the Action original-binary path when a newer CLI supports it.

Remove inherited GOROOT before querying the selected entry; require exact actual GOVERSION/GOROOT/GOOS/GOARCH against the verified manifest. Preserve tracing environment and PATH while retaining local toolchain and offline sealed module constraints.
Use a fresh compiler cache, require actual build completion, and revalidate pinned preparation afterwards.

Add direct entry, mismatch/refusal, real shell argument/environment and workflow-order regressions. Helper, preparation and Security workflow changes must select the new regression, or require audit if it is absent.
whyEarlierChecksMissedIt: Prior local tests proved actual Go compilation and immutable dependency inputs but did not run CodeQL extraction or exercise its initialized executable. The helper had no direct tracing-entry regression. The former selector mapped it only to general tooling tests, which could remain green while no source was extracted.
analogousReview: Verified the preparation-only Python environment remains intentionally sealed; it runs before tracing and should not carry tracing credentials into downloads.
Verified pinned Action permits either wrapper or compiler according to the CLI feature, so the fix does not hard-code a wrapper requirement forever.
Verified downstream build invocation, source/material hashes, offline module settings and selector/test inventory preserve existing fail-closed behavior.
Independent runtime and WEB reviewers read pinned Action sources and the four changed files; no further actionable issue was reported.

final.goSourceCoverage: 1 of 2 Go files; main_test.go is excluded by the extractor default, not silently counted as analyzed.

actualScanner.network: CLI archive and official GHCR package layers downloaded publicly and SHA256 verified. Twelve exact query/dependency packages were transferred to task storage, then analysis ran with --no-download and blocked network proxies. No model inference or MCP invocation.
retainedPreparationIssues: The initial direct Linux pack download timed out; its log is retained. The successful route used official public OCI artifacts downloaded locally.
The first registry tag page was limited to100 entries; the full page yielded go-queries1.6.14. Initially downloaded older1.4.9 packages were not used by the final analysis.

real shell entry forwards arguments and tracing environment to the backend

initialFailuresRetained.cause: I omitted HARNESS_TEST_PYTHON in the initial eight-module Windows launch. Three real-Python fixture tests returned python-interpreter-unavailable. The same group passed after supplying the prescribed pinned interpreter; no assertion or source fix was used to erase the failure.

The default overloaded execFileSync inferred an overly broad injection type; a narrow three-argument executor wrapper and a complete failed-prerequisite fixture resolved the type errors. Initial type log retained; final helper bytes were used in real scanner validation.

prevention: Successful compilation is not proof of CodeQL extraction: require actual nonempty source extraction/finalize and real rule analysis for changes to compiler/tracer integration.
Perform tool setup and verified PATH publication before CodeQL init; always invoke and validate the entry selected by init.
Keep direct regression coverage selected for all three integration inputs and fail closed if that regression is absent.
Keep platform skips explicit and supply the pinned Python when a targeted tooling test invokes Python indirectly.

primarySources.purpose: No-source failure meaning and compiler-observation contract
Official fixed CLI asset and SHA256

limits: The local real CodeQL run validates the reviewed Go module using the same CLI and current official Go query pack. It is not a substitute for the pending hosted Security run or hosted full Reviewed matrix.
CodeQL Action control flow itself was not executed locally inside a GitHub runner; its exact pinned source and wrapper body were independently inspected and reproduced.
No full repository audit or full test matrix was started in this repair turn. The next unchanged candidate requires a fresh complete audit and the parent-authorized hosted gates.

No online service, deployment configuration, prior failed candidate checkout or old failure artifact was altered. All tooling and evidence were confined to task-owned D-drive and isolated Linux paths.
The separate hosted Windows Reviewed failure remains under investigation; this Go fix does not resolve or dismiss it.
